2027-02-01.name: Daily #123
hints: The beam already passes close to the seed. One mass beside it can pull it across. Pearl walls are mirrors: follow the light past its bounce.
The marked sphere holds the mass, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam.
A medium mass one and a half shadow-widths from the beam, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam, turns it onto the seed. It bounces off a pearl wall on the way.
